topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the final lecture of the course and outlines the learning objectives for cancer therapy.

topics.label: Surgical, Radiotherapeutic, and Cytotoxic Approaches
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss conventional cancer treatment modalities including surgical removal, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapy along with their mechanisms and limitations.

topics.label: Exploiting Intrinsic Cancer Cell Vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies that take advantage of specific cancer cell vulnerabilities, including hormone dependence, cell cycle checkpoint defects, and DNA repair deficiencies.

topics.label: Oncogene Targeting and Kinase Inhibitors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine targeted therapies designed against driving oncogenic mutations and kinases, along with the development and clinical management of drug resistance.

topics.label: Therapeutic Monoclonal Antibodies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the mechanisms and therapeutic applications of monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates directed against tumor surface antigens.

topics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy and Cellular Strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the role of the immune system in cancer surveillance and the application of checkpoint inhibitors, bispecific T-cell engagers, and CAR T-cell therapies.

topics.label: Clinical Challenges, Progress, and Future Outlook
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess overall clinical challenges, historical advances in patient survival, future therapeutic developments, and treatment dilemmas in oncology.
